{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column more closely
current_revenue_dtype = sales_df['revenue'].dtype
print(f"Revenue column dtype: {current_revenue_dtype}")

# Check for non-numeric values in revenue
revenue_sample = sales_df['revenue'].head(10)
print("Sample of revenue values:", revenue_sample.values)

# Check for any non-numeric characters in the revenue column
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.]', na=False)
print("Rows with non-numeric characters in revenue:", non_numeric_revenue.sum())

# Look at those rows
if non_numeric_revenue.sum() > 0:
    problematic_rows = sales_df[non_numeric_revenue]
    print("Problematic rows:\n", problematic_rows[['order_id', 'revenue']])

# Remove non-numeric characters and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]', '', regex=True)

# Convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
dropped_rows = sales_df['revenue_clean'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Number of rows with invalid revenue after cleaning: {dropped_rows}")

# Confirm the new dtype
print(f"New revenue_clean dtype: {sales_df['revenue_clean'].dtype}")"}
